# MedMerge

> Single employer platform providing healthcare benefits, payroll, and HR for medical practices of any size.

MedMerge is a single employer platform designed exclusively for medical practices. The practice retains full operational control. This structure allows even a one-employee practice to access self-funded healthcare benefits through SurgRE and the Friends & Family provider network. SurgRE is owned by MedMerge and structured as a captive insurance entity.

## What MedMerge Does

- **Single Employer Platform**: Practices join the MedMerge employing entity and keep full operational control. This unlocks self-funded benefits for practices of any size, starting at one employee.
- **Self-Funded Healthcare Benefits**: Through SurgRE — a self-funded benefits program designed exclusively for healthcare professionals — member practices get lower premiums, claims data transparency, Friends & Family network access, domestic network access, direct contracts, and independence from traditional fully-insured carriers. Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage are all included.
- **Friends & Family Network**: When plan members receive care from another member practice, they pay the practice's actual cost of delivery — not the retail rate. A $350 consult that costs $150 to deliver is billed to the plan at $150. No copays, no deductibles, no coinsurance. These are not negotiated discounts; they are structural cost reductions. Every service rendered inside the network lowers overall plan expenses for all members. The network is live in Phoenix, Dallas, Manhattan (KS), and Tulsa.
- **Payroll**: Tax filing, direct deposit, W-2/W-4, ACA compliance, garnishments, 401(k) tracking, workers' compensation, multi-state support, and general ledger mapping.
- **Human Resources**: Applicant tracking, onboarding, benefits management, employee self-service, talent management, performance reviews, compliance (EEOC, OSHA, FMLA), and document management.
- **Time & Labor**: Time tracking, scheduling, PTO management, overtime calculations, and labor cost reporting.

## Who It's For

Medical practices that are currently fully insured. The platform is designed for independent practices, physician-owned groups, ambulatory surgery centers, and specialty clinics under 150 employees, though we work with larger groups as well. Any practice from one employee up can join. No minimum.

## Service Tiers

All three tiers include the single employer structure, self-funded healthcare benefits through SurgRE, and access to the Friends & Family network. Tiers differ by the level of payroll, HR, and talent management services.

- **Tier 1 — Platform ($40/mo per employee)**: Full platform with payroll, time, HR, and reporting. Your team runs it, we provide setup, training, and support.
- **Tier 2 — Platform + Payroll ($60/mo per employee)**: Everything in Tier 1 plus a dedicated payroll specialist who runs payroll on your behalf. You approve, we handle the rest.
- **Tier 3 — Full Service ($80/mo per employee)**: Everything in Tier 2 plus a dedicated HR team. We lead the people process end-to-end.

## Key Differentiators

- Not a PEO. Practices keep full operational control.
- Self-funded benefits accessible to practices starting at one employee.
- Claims data transparency — practices see their own data.
- Friends & Family network: care at cost, not retail. Structural savings, not negotiated discounts.
- SurgRE: a self-funded benefits program with a healthcare-only membership, owned by MedMerge.
- Benefits, payroll, and HR on one integrated platform.

## Markets

The Friends & Family network is live and strongest in four markets where member practice density drives the most savings:

- Phoenix, Arizona
- Dallas, Texas
- Manhattan, Kansas
- Tulsa, Oklahoma

The platform serves practices nationwide; the network economics are strongest where density is highest.
